title: Checkmate in two
source: Original positions composed for this project by games/compose-chess.ts and verified with chess.js (not taken from any game or puzzle database).

hints: Look for a move that does not give check yet, but takes away the king's squares so that any reply allows mate next move.
puzzles.explain: After Ra7, the black king is trapped: whatever Black plays, White has checkmate on the next move. For example Ra7 Kf8 Rh8#.
